title: 第724章 特例第723章 太虚之力神威
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
这些人本以为。
这两场擂台赛，是星斗天阙给他们送源晶的福利局。
却不成想。
他们自己，才是那个最大的福利……
只有极少数人，没有亏本。
其中，自然就包括洛星凝与燕知微二人。
休息室中。
“哈哈哈！”
“发了发了！”
“知微，我们发财了啊！”
“八十亿！整整八十亿源晶！”
“我还没见过这么多的源晶呢！”
洛星凝看着已经到账的八十亿源晶，顿时激动不已。
就连一向沉稳的燕知微，此刻也是满脸笑容，心中无比欣喜。
他们打赢一场擂台赛，也才只有几百万源晶。
这么一对比。
两者相差，足以用天壤之别来形容。
“可惜，这么好的机会，只有一次。”
“唉，要是能多来几次，哪里还需要我们辛苦打擂台赛啊？”
“你就知足吧。”

“八十亿源晶，已经很多了。”
“至少够我们用很长一段时间了。”
“嘿嘿，说的也是。”
“不过嘛，谁会嫌弃源晶多呢？”
“待会我们这样。”
“我的擂台赛，你拿着全部源晶，压我赢。”
“同样，你的擂台赛，我拿着全部源晶去压你赢。”
“虽然赚的不多，但不要白不要嘛。”
听着洛星凝的提议，燕知微没有多想，便点头答应下来。
另一边。
星斗天阙，最顶层的房间中。
“少主，那两人的实力，非比寻常。”
“尤其是那个风燕，掌握着能吞噬他人力量的手段。”
“连即将突破到造化境的红菱，都毫无抵抗之力。”
content_en:
These people thought.
These two arena matches were a welfare bureau for Xingdou Tianque to give them source crystals.
But it didn't come true.
They themselves are the greatest welfare...
Only a very small number of people did not lose money.
Among them, Luo Xingning and Yan Zhiwei were naturally included.
In the lounge.
"Hahaha!"
"It's been done!"
"Zhiwei, we are rich!"
"Eight billion! Eight billion source crystals!"
"I have never seen so many source crystals!"
Luo Xingning looked at the eight billion source crystals that had arrived and was immediately excited.
Even Yan Zhiwei, who had always been calm, was smiling with joy in her heart.
They only had a few million source crystals to win an arena match.
Such a comparison.
The difference between the two is enough to be described as worlds apart.
"It's a pity that such a good opportunity only comes once."
"Well, if we could come here a few more times, why would we need to work so hard in the arena?"
"Just be content."
"Eight billion source crystals is already a lot."
"At least enough to last us a long time."
"Hehe, that's true."
"But, who would dislike Yuan Jingduo?"
"We'll do this later."
"In my arena match, you hold all the source crystals and beat me to win."
"Similarly, in your arena match, I will use all the source crystals to defeat you and win."
“Although I don’t earn much, I don’t want to give it up for free.”
After hearing Luo Xingning's suggestion, Yan Zhiwei nodded and agreed without thinking too much.
other side.
Star Tower, in the room on the top floor.
"Young Master, the strength of those two people is extraordinary."
"Especially that Feng Yan, who has the means to swallow up the power of others."
"Even Hong Ling, who is about to break through to the realm of creation, has no power to resist."
